payload.reason: The evidence provides specific rules and considerations for assigning error categories based on part-of-speech and types of errors.

claims.text: Error categories are assigned based on part-of-speech (POS) classifications and specific rules for Missing, Unnecessary, and Replacement errors.
The framework for error categorization aims to balance informativeness and practicality, avoiding overly detailed distinctions.
Approximately 50 rules were developed to classify errors, with particular attention to different types of verb errors.
